description: This Java class defines the OrderService, which handles order management operations within an online shopping system, including creating and retrieving orders, updating order status, and canceling orders, with integration to repositories and security context.

classes.name: OrderService
classes.description: Service class providing order management features such as creating orders, retrieving orders, updating status, and canceling.

methods.name: getAllOrders
methods.description: Retrieve all orders with pagination, accessible to admin users.

methods.name: getCurrentUserOrders
methods.description: Retrieve current user's orders with pagination.

methods.name: getOrderById
methods.description: Fetch a specific order by its ID.

methods.name: createOrder
methods.description: Create a new order from the current user's cart, updating stock and clearing the cart.

methods.name: updateOrderStatus
methods.description: Update the status of an existing order, typically by admins.

methods.name: cancelOrder
methods.description: Cancel an existing order and restore product stock.
